description.content: Get NFT metadata for one or many NFTs. Accepts an array of up to 25 `tokens`, each requiring `token_address` and `token_id`. Each NFT returned includes on-chain metadata as well as off-chain metadata, floor prices, rarity and more where available.

response.name: Returns a collection of NFT owners

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
